annotation.title_clean: EDPB-EDPS Joint Opinion 5/2021 on the proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.title_en: EDPB-EDPS Joint Opinion 5/2021 on the proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Data Protection Board (EDPB); European Data Protection Supervisor (EDPS)
annotation.summary_en: Joint opinion of the EDPB and EDPS on the Commission's 2021 AI Act proposal. It welcomes the risk-based approach but urges stronger data protection alignment, broader bans (social scoring, biometric identification in public spaces, emotion inference), third-party conformity assessment, independent DPA-led supervision, and clearer rules on sandboxes, standards and codes of conduct.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for a general ban on AI-based remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces.
Recommends prohibiting all social scoring, biometric categorisation and emotion inference (with narrow exceptions).
Requires third-party ex-ante conformity assessment for all high-risk AI systems.
Recommends designating data protection authorities as national supervisory authorities and strengthening European AI Board independence.
Asks that sandboxes, certification, standards and codes of conduct align with GDPR and EUDPR.
